description: This file is part of the Twig templating engine, specifically responsible for parsing expressions within Twig templates. It implements precedence climbing algorithm for parsing various expressions, handles function calls, filters, operators, and different expression types.

classes.name: ExpressionParser
classes.description: The ExpressionParser class parses Twig expressions using a precedence climbing algorithm, handling operators, functions, filters, unary and binary expressions, and various expression types within Twig templates.

methods.name: parseExpression
methods.description: Parses a Twig expression with optional operator precedence, implements precedence climbing, handles ternary, binary, unary, and primary expressions.

methods.name: getPrimary
methods.description: Gets the primary expression node, handling literals, variables, grouped expressions, and function calls.

methods.name: parseConditionalExpression
methods.description: Parses ternary conditional expressions within Twig templates.

methods.name: isUnary
methods.description: Checks if the current token is a unary operator.

methods.name: isBinary
methods.description: Checks if the current token is a binary operator.

methods.name: parsePrimaryExpression
methods.description: Parses primary expressions like literals, variable names, parenthesized expressions, and function calls.

methods.name: parseStringExpression
methods.description: Parses string expressions, including concatenations and interpolations.

methods.name: parseArrayExpression
methods.description: Deprecated; use parseSequenceExpression(). Parses array-like expressions.

methods.name: parseSequenceExpression
methods.description: Parses list (array) expressions enclosed in brackets.

methods.name: parseHashExpression
methods.description: Deprecated; use parseMappingExpression(). Parses map/dictionary expressions.

methods.name: parseMappingExpression
methods.description: Parses key-value mapping (dictionary) expressions enclosed in braces.

methods.name: parsePostfixExpression
methods.description: Handles postfix operators like member access and filters.

methods.name: getFunctionNode
methods.description: Retrieves or constructs a function node for function calls within expressions.

methods.name: parseSubscriptExpression
methods.description: Parses subscript expression syntax, such as property access or method call.

methods.name: parseFilterExpression
methods.description: Parses filter application syntax.

methods.name: parseFilterExpressionRaw
methods.description: Parses filter expressions with arguments.

methods.name: createArguments
methods.description: Creates argument nodes for function calls based on parsed arguments.

methods.name: parseOnlyArguments
methods.description: Parses argument list for function or filter calls.

methods.name: checkConstantExpression
methods.description: Checks if a node contains only constant expressions.

methods.name: setDeprecationCheck
methods.description: Enables or disables deprecation checks during parsing.
